WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    p.payment_type,
    o.order_purchase_timestamp,
    c.customer_state,
    c.customer_id IS NULL AS customer_missing
  FROM payments.order_payments p
  JOIN orders.orders o ON p.order_id = o.order_id
  LEFT JOIN orders.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-02-01'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-04-01'
),
mg AS (
  SELECT * FROM base WHERE customer_state = 'MG'
),
window_stats AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS n_total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN payment_type = 'boleto' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_boleto,
    SUM(CASE WHEN payment_type IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_null_type
  FROM mg
  WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-03-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-04-01'
),
baseline_stats AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS n_total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN payment_type = 'boleto' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_boleto,
    SUM(CASE WHEN payment_type IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_null_type
  FROM mg
  WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-02-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-03-01'
),
unjoined AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-03-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-04-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_window,
    SUM(CASE WHEN order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-02-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-03-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_baseline
  FROM base
  WHERE customer_state <> 'MG' OR customer_missing
)
SELECT
  ROUND(w.n_boleto::DOUBLE / NULLIF(w.n_total, 0), 4) AS value,
  ROUND(b.n_boleto::DOUBLE / NULLIF(b.n_total, 0), 4) AS baseline,
  w.n_total AS window_total_payments,
  b.n_total AS baseline_total_payments,
  w.n_boleto AS window_boleto_payments,
  b.n_boleto AS baseline_boleto_payments,
  w.n_null_type AS window_null_payment_type,
  b.n_null_type AS baseline_null_payment_type,
  u.n_window AS window_unjoined_non_mg,
  u.n_baseline AS baseline_unjoined_non_mg
FROM window_stats w, baseline_stats b, unjoined u;
